chatgpt_2d_sweep.finding: Cross-paper replication confirmed: ChatGPT modularity 0.752 (this paper) vs 0.749 (Paper 1), despite different embedding model (OAI-small-256 vs nomic-768) and threshold (0.84 vs 0.90).

weight_sensitivity.finding: Optimal role weighting is platform-dependent. ChatGPT peaks with user-heavy weighting (uw=3-5), Claude Code peaks with assistant-heavy weighting (uw=0.5). Reflects conversational vs agentic interaction modalities.

analytical.purpose: maximize community structure for paper findings

operational.purpose: navigable graph for semantic search and recommendations

dual_threshold.finding: Analytical and operational thresholds diverge. Community structure is maximized at sparser graphs, but utility requires denser connectivity.
